patthana19.6:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca savitakka savicāro dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā. na savitakka savicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakka vicāramatto dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, na savitakka savicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakka avicāro dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, satta.
patthana19.6:2.1: na avitakka avicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakka vicāramatto dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, satta.
patthana19.6:3.1: na avitakka avicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakka avicāro dhammo upapajjati hetupaccayā, satta.
